name: S2_READ_MODEL_20261114
comment: ANCHOR: S2_READ_MODEL — S2 item 2 / ACC-CACHE (cc-deepseek-9). No GET computes: /api/v2/home/do-now reads HomeDoNowSnapshot@v1 written by the lane home-do-now-snapshot, and /api/v2/overview reads OverviewProjection@v1 through a reader that takes no compute callable at all. Cold start, cache miss, an aged/expired/corrupt/not-ok product, a body from another release and an outage each answer a labelled LAST-KNOWN-GOOD or a NAMED UNKNOWN (counts null, never zero) — never a request-thread build.

Contract: the route half of this gate is RED on a branch where the api_v2.py patch is not applied (measured 2026-11-14 on 52ab48c26: 2 failed / 7 errors / 36 passed — the home-do-now route, its auth helper and its projected-cache bound are in the hot file), and GREEN with PATCH-S2-read-model-r4-52ab48c26-cc-deepseek-9.patch applied (45 passed). The store/reader/producer half is green either way.

Producer executability (REVIEW-S2-ACC-CACHE F1, cc-deepseek-2): test_the_producer_build_executes_end_to_end calls api_v2._home_do_now_build() — the function the lane runs — with only lib.data_broker.home_do_now.build stubbed, so the function body executes. It is not a patch-presence test (its subject exists on both sides); its mutant is the r3 defect: a dead write to the removed _HOME_DO_NOW_CACHE before the return is a NameError that kills the lane, and that mutant is red here (measured 2026-11-14: 1 failed / 29 deselected).

api_v2.py is a shared hot file owned by the integrator: this gate does not imply api_v2 alone — apply the patch and this gate in one release, and carry the retirement of tests/test_s2_home_do_now_swr_20261114.py and S2_HOME_SWR_R6_20261114 in that same release, because this gate's route supersedes its stale-while-revalidate containment (measured 2026-11-14: that file is 9 passed without the patch, 1 failed / 8 errors with it). They are already archive-moved on this branch to archive/s2_home_swr_r6_retired_20261114/ (see its TRIPWIRE.md and the ARCHIVE_MANIFEST entries); the fold must carry the move, not re-register either path.
Synthetic documents and a scratch snapshot path only; no production DB, no Valkey, no scheduled job.
